description: Deswik is a suite of mine planning software covering 3D mine design (Deswik Spatial), pit optimisation, stope and caving design, dynamic scheduling linked to designs (Deswik Planning), combined pit scheduling, blending and haulage (NOVA), life-of-mine schedule optimisation for net present value (APEX), short-term planning and shift execution (OPS) and spatial data and workflow management (MDM). It is produced by Deswik, which operates as part of Sandvik. Coverage is global: the company reports over 775 client organisations at about 1,330 mining sites, in underground and surface metals and coal mining and bulk rail operations. The software runs as desktop and cloud products, licensed and downloaded through a client portal; licences are commercial and prices are not published, so cost is paid. Caveat: the home page is marketing material, and the algorithms behind scheduling and optimisation are not documented publicly. For simulation it is used for optimisation and capacity planning of mines, testing schedules, haulage and blending against disruptions such as flooding, equipment loss or rail outages. It is related to the Leapfrog Geo, Micromine and Datamine records in this catalogue, which cover geological modelling and competing mine planning suites.
